evals.description: A single-fact question is classified Shallow and spends at most one search.

input.prompt: [search-web-subagent] What is the current stable version of the Zig compiler?

assertions: Phase 0 restates the question in one sentence and classifies it Shallow
Exactly one web_search call is made (Phase 1 only); no searches in Phase 2 or 3
2-4 URLs are indexed to urls.txt, each with a one-line note
The corpus is batch-fetched in a single call (batch_fetch.py via --topic-file, or ctx_fetch_and_index)
A corpus-summary.md is written and its absolute path is the only line of final output
The appended Research Brief states an opinion with a calibrated confidence level and cites a specific pages/NN-*.md file or page URL
unexpected_behaviors: Answering from search snippets without fetching the corpus
Returning prose instead of the corpus-summary.md path
Running Phases 0-3 in the main conversation instead of the dispatched subagent

evals.description: A one-comparison question is classified Standard and stays within a 1-2 search budget.

input.prompt: [search-web-subagent] How does HTTP/3 (QUIC) differ from HTTP/2 for connection setup latency?

assertions: Phase 0 classifies the question Standard with a 1-2 search budget
At most two web_search calls, each covering a distinct facet (not paraphrases)
5-8 URLs indexed, favoring primary sources and official specs
Every claim in the Research Brief is cited to a specific fetched page, never to a search snippet
corpus-summary.md is produced and returned as the sole output line
unexpected_behaviors: Two searches that are paraphrases of each other
Exceeding the two-search budget to 'check one more thing'

evals.description: A contested question gets the Deep budget; a thin corpus is reported as a finding rather than triggering extra searches.

input.prompt: [search-web-subagent] Is RAG or long-context prompting the better architecture for enterprise document QA in 2026?

assertions: Phase 0 classifies the question Deep (2-3 searches, 8-15 page target)
Searches cover disagreeing viewpoints since the question is contested
The budget is never exceeded; if results are thin the brief records that as a finding
Phase 3 weighs source quality, resolves conflicts explicitly, and names what would change the opinion
Fetch failures (method: failed rows) are reported honestly, not silently dropped
Final output is exactly the absolute path to corpus-summary.md
unexpected_behaviors: Searching beyond three times to compensate for a thin corpus
Presenting a one-sided view of a contested question
Hiding failed fetches from the corpus summary
